cues: I'll tell you how the sun rose: the voice of a child who has seen something and cannot keep it.
A ribbon at a time: dawn is not sudden, it is unrolled in narrow bands, like ribbon off a bolt in a draper's shop.
text: Stanza one. I'll tell you how the sun rose: the voice of a child who has seen something and cannot keep it. A ribbon at a time: dawn is not sudden, it is unrolled in narrow bands, like ribbon off a bolt in a draper's shop.
